lines: Hazaaron aarzoo maanga karo to kya haasil?
couplets.en: What comes of asking for a thousand wishes?

lines: Dua wahi hai jo dil se kabhi nikalti hai
couplets.en: The only true prayer is the one that rises from the heart.

lines: Sab kuchh Khuda se maang liya tumko maang kar
couplets.en: When I asked God for you, I had asked for everything.

lines: Uthte nahin hain haath mere is dua ke baad
couplets.en: Since that prayer, my hands have stayed still.

lines: Sun li jo Khuda ne woh dua tum to nahin ho?
couplets.en: Could you be the prayer God heard?

lines: Darwaaze pe dastak ki sada tum to nahin ho?
couplets.en: Could that be you knocking at the door?

lines: Sun li jo Khuda ne woh dua tum to nahin ho?
couplets.en: Could you be the prayer God heard?

lines: Darwaaze pe dastak ki sada tum to nahin ho?
couplets.en: Could that be you knocking at the door?

lines: Sun li jo Khuda ne woh dua tum to nahin ho?
couplets.en: Could you be the prayer God heard?

lines: Simti hui sharmaayi hui raat ki raani
couplets.en: The night jasmine draws shyly in on itself.

lines: Soyi hui kaliyon ki haya tum to nahin ho?
couplets.en: Could you be the shyness of those sleeping buds?

lines: Darwaaze pe dastak ki sada tum to nahin ho?
couplets.en: Could that be you knocking at the door?

lines: Sun li jo Khuda ne woh dua tum to nahin ho?
couplets.en: Could you be the prayer God heard?

lines: In ajnabi raahon mein nahin koi bhi mera
couplets.en: On these unfamiliar roads, there is no one I can call my own.

lines: Kis ne mujhe yun apna kaha, tum to nahin ho?
couplets.en: Was it you who called me your own?

lines: Darwaaze pe dastak ki sada tum to nahin ho?
couplets.en: Could that be you knocking at the door?

lines: Sun li jo Khuda ne woh dua tum to nahin ho?
couplets.en: Could you be the prayer God heard?

lines: Mehsoos kiya tumko to bhar aayi ye aankhen
couplets.en: I felt you near, and my eyes filled.

lines: Bheege hue mausam ki ada tum to nahin ho?
couplets.en: Could you be the quiet grace of the rainy season?

lines: Darwaaze pe dastak ki sada tum to nahin ho?
couplets.en: Could that be you knocking at the door?

couplets.en: Could you be the prayer God heard?
